title: Strings and Printing vars.
description:
## Strings
There is one more datatype in rust, &str. &str is a string of text, such as `"Hello, World!"`.
You can print a variable in rust using this format: `println!("{}", var_name);`. In order of args passed, {}s are replaced with the var passed, so in this example it would just print the var named var_name.
---
## Assignment:
Make a simple function that takes a &str and prints it called `print_str`.
